The '''Pirates' Cove''' is a small island located in the [[Northern Ocean]] north of the [[Fremennik Province]]. It is the current docking place of the [[Lady Zay]], a massive pirate vessel known for its unlawful activity in the region. The player is first taken to the island by the [[Fremennik]] [[pirate]] [[Lokar Searunner]] during the [[Lunar Diplomacy]] quest, and may visit it again at any point afterwards by speaking to Lokar at the port in [[Rellekka]].

The island is totally uninhabited except for some [[moss giant]]s. A number of pirates can also be found wandering the island, although they are presumably crewmen aboard the Lady Zay and not permanent residents. Although the Lady Zay's crew typically appear to remain onboard their ship whenever possible, evidence of their activity on the island is obvious; supply crates, basic fences, flags, and other materials can be found dotted around the area, and a number of skeletal corpses can be found hanging from poles on the island's peak.

==Transportation==
The Pirates' Cove can be accessed only by boat. Players may reach the island either by speaking to [[Lokar Searunner]] in [[Rellekka]], provided they have completed the [[The Fremennik Trials]] quest (must start Lunar Diplomacy in order for Lokar Searunner to speak to you), or by talking to [[Captain Bentley]] on [[Lunar Isle]], provided they have reached a certain point in [[Lunar Diplomacy]]. There is no fee either way. With 76 [[Sailing]], a rowboat may be built at the [[Buccaneers' Haven]] to access this island, though it requires partial completion of Lunar Diplomacy to use.

There are no [[teleportation]] methods through which a player can immediately reach the island; however, players may reach the Lady Zay's port of call on Lunar Isle more quickly by using the [[Lunar Home Teleport]] or the [[Moonclan Teleport]] found in the [[Lunar spellbook]], which is a reward for the Lunar Diplomacy quest. Players can also access Rellekka more quickly through a variety of means, including the [[enchanted lyre]] or [[teleport to house]] spell (provided their [[player-owned house]] is in Rellekka).

[[File:Lady Zay.png|thumb|right|The [[Lady Zay]], a [[pirate]] vessel known to dock at the cove.]]

==Features==
{{See also|Lady Zay}}
[[File:Moss giant.png|thumb|upright|A [[moss giant]], the cove's only native [[race]].]]
The cove's primary attraction is its large moss giant population. The moss giants that wander the island are level 48, as opposed to their much more common level 42 counterparts. Moss giants are popular for their fairly high hitpoints and limited strength. They can also drop a number of potentially desirable items, including a variety of [[weapon]]s, [[armour]], [[gem]]s, [[seeds]], and [[herb]]s. The moss giants are aggressive to players level 96 and under. The nearest full [[bank]]ing facilities can be found on the [[Moon Clan]] settlement on Lunar Isle.

In addition to Moss Giants, a number of attackable pirates can be found wandering the island. Two of these are standard level 23 [[pirate]]s. In addition, three named pirates - [[Jake]], [[Palmer]], and [[Wilson]] - can also be found on the island. Each is level 37. These pirates can be fought if desired, but do not drop anything other than [[bones]].

A number of other facilities can be found aboard the Lady Zay itself, including a [[range]] and several barrels containing potentially useful items such as [[swamp tar]] and [[cooking apple]]s. Players can access the Zay by ascending via ladder to the top of the dock on the island's south-eastern side, either from the small islet on which Lokar docks his rowboat or the island itself.

==Personalities==
With the exception of Lokar Searunner, the entire [[NPC]] population of Pirates' Cove exists aboard the Lady Zay. Lokar himself can be found near his rowboat, which is separated from the rest of the cove by the island's dock.
